Answer: Question: Why are there so many corrupt federal agents? Is it the culture of federal law enforcement to simply do as they please due to a lack of oversight, were they given carte blanche to violate anyone they deem morally unfit, not pro America, unproductive? There are relatively few “corrupt” federal agents overall, querent. The fact that organized criminals are going to prison quite frequently is a testament to that fact. After all, if they are making enough to bribe federal agents, why would they even worry about the prison system? They could simply pay the right people and then walk away from the majority of offenses. This is how it was during Prohibition and things have changed since then. Now…is corruption a problem? Certainly: The Border Patrol among federal law enforcement agencies seems to have significant problems with corruption. However even there the majority of their agents are not “on the take” and many are simply trying to perform their roles to the best of their abilities. Question: Are there any ostensible one hit wonders with better songs than their hit? Which one hit wonders to the UK and US had songs that were uncharted or only local hits but were better than the hit they were famous for?
Answer: Question: Are there any ostensible one hit wonders with better songs than their hit? Which one hit wonders to the UK and US had songs that were uncharted or only local hits but were better than the hit they were famous for? many so-called “one hit wonders” in the United States were actually R&B performers who had multiple hits on the soul charts and overseas. They just had a single song which hit on the Hot 100 pop charts and thus earned the sobriquet. Some examples: Debarge - The group had one Top Hot 100 with Rhythm of The Night but multiple R&B hits like “All This Love” and “Love Me In A Special Way” that topped the R&B and Adult Contemporary charts. Also the lead singe, El Debarge had a Number #3 pop hit with the “Who Is Johnny?” title song from the film Short Circuit. Bobby McFerrin - His earworm “Don’t Worry,Be Happy” was his only pop hit. However McFerrin had been and is a jazz artist of renown and had been for many decades, many of which are superior to his pop hit. Julie London - A torch singer from the 1950s whose main claims to fame were her marriage to television actor/producer Jack Webb and her supporting role in television drama Emergency in the 1970s had a single pop hit with the standard “Cry Me A River”. However her album “Round Midnight” had multiple covers of other standards that were as good, if not better, than her one pop hit. Acker Bilk - Had a one hit in the United States with the instrumental Stranger On The Shore. However Bilk performed many, many other songs including 1975’s “Aria” which was a hit in the United Kingdom, but didn’t chart here in the US. Astrid Gilberto - Had a huge hit with 1963’s “Girl From Ipanema”. However her 1965 self-titled album contains her singing multiple covers of song and is far superior to her one hit wonder.

Question: What would happen if you sent your friend in Boot Camp a dirty magazine to cheer them and their friends up?
Answer: Question: What would happen if you sent your friend in Boot Camp a dirty magazine to cheer them and their friends up? It would be seized when it reached the base’s mail depot. Recruits are informed that pornography and intimate pictures are against the rules and technically potential violations of the Uniformed Code of Military Justice of which you learn throughout your time in basic training. Even if you, the recruit, did not request such material you would face punishment for it. And, ironically, you’d probably never even get to see what you’re being disciplined for unless it was evidence at a court martial. Secondhand war story - My best friend in high school went into the US Navy but was seriously injured during basic training and received a medical discharge as a result. Apparently some one in his basic unit had photos that were criminal in nature sent to him, and after interrogation he rather foolishly admitted that he had asked to be mailed them. He was court martialed (according to someone my friend stayed in touch with) and he went Leavenworth before he ever entered the “Real Navy”. Given that this was in the mid-1980s, his being a sex offender was likely not well-received when he got there. EVERYTHING sent to you in basic training is checked out and/or x-rayed and opened to ensure that contraband (normally they are searching for weapons or drugs) doesn’t get through. If you have someone who might consider sending you such a “surprise” it’s a good idea to warn them not to if they don’t want to harm your military career.
